budget_items.what_was_recorded: A one-year CTE operations and maintenance contract starting 7/1/22, approved by the Commission.
budget_items.quote: the 1-year contract is for $85,443.44 and starts 7/1/22.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Q4 bills went out on 5/19 for a total commitment that the Commission accepted.
budget_items.quote: barb reported the q4 bills went out on 5/19 for a total of $275,803.50.

budget_items.topic: FY22 budget outcome and Retained Earnings
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A FY22 loss was anticipated, but a surplus is reported, a gain of about $600K for Retained Earnings; back betterments from Meadowwoods will boost Retained Earnings; another loss year is expected from debt expense.
budget_items.quote: they anticipated a loss of $343k but have a surplus of $288k, which is a gain of about $600k for retained earnings.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Upland/Eastern and White/Maple Parkway extension betterment figure remains the engineers' estimate.
budget_items.quote: the betterment figure will still be $57k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Monthly Fitchburg usage, Q4 Leominster usage (about $20K higher than the prior Q4), and Wright Pierce and Sewer Bylaw work invoices were presented; the Commission agreed to pay them.
budget_items.quote: invoices- fitchburg usage - $19,174.13 (monthly), leominster-$138,839.20 (q4-12/26-3/25)- which was about $20k higher than the last q4 figure

budget_items.topic: Whalom work funding and rate increase
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Discussion of the availability of money for Whalom work and a suggestion to consider ARPA or Build Back Better funds; a suggestion to consider a flat annual rate increase to cover Fitchburg and Leominster cost increases. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: followed regarding availability of money to work on whalom.
